notes.en: I aimed for a quiet engraved study: a solid gold figure carrying the dual pose, with the ink reserved for pose separations, a calm long-haired face, and sparse muscle marks, so the mark decays gracefully from full anatomy at 280px to a plain gold glyph in the navbar. Five render passes went into limb mass and the overlap zones at shoulder and hip. Still weak: the horizontal hands are mittens rather than open hands, the spread feet flatten into wedges against the circle, and the chest marks read more like engraving shorthand than real pectorals.
